purpose: Transparent illustrated character-ball assets; robotic companion revision rejected by user; final companions restore original girl-dumpling style with small brand-reference accessories, pending in-game aesthetic acceptance.

entries.prompt: Production GAME SPRITE CUTOUT. Use ONLY the blue whale-maid spherical heroine at TOP LEFT of the reference board as the identity/style reference. Produce ONE isolated, centered, large round dumpling-ball heroine, facing forward, on genuine transparent background. Preserve the approved face: expressive big cobalt eyes, blue fringe, white ruffled maid headband, whale ear fins, navy bows, tiny white apron crescent with whale emblem, short curved whale tail and curled ahoge. No rice bowl, no chopsticks, no tiny duplicate character, no scale diagram, no text, no ground shadow, no label, no scenery, no aura, no circle bubble enclosing a person. Her own round compact head-and-body forms the sphere, not an ordinary animal whale. Matte hand-painted anime cel shading, confident dark contours, simple readable facial features designed to remain legible at 58 pixels. Front view, symmetric centered circular body occupying 80% of square canvas, only short fins/tail extend slightly, leave safe transparent margins. No glossy plastic, no 3D render. High-quality square 1024x1024 sprite.

This subtle OpenAI-inspired knot is an accessory, NOT the head itself and NOT a big central logo. Face should occupy at least half the round body. Adorable squishy ball girl, no arms or long torso.
